info.summary: Events and registrations for the leader team
Veranstaltungen und Anmeldungen für die Leiterrunde
info.description:
Events module of the Leiterrunde suite – requires the Leiterrunde app.
Event planning and registration management:
• Events with team roles, team check and linked staff • Budget calculation and cost tracking per event • Registrations for participants • Appointment sync (Termine) to the public website with retry via background job • Publish workflow with secret-key settings • Backfill of payment obligations to the Finances module
Requires the Leiterrunde app for persons, roles and permissions.
